messages:
lucy (support): hey team — customer acme-121 is seeing lots of 504s and timeouts on hosted inference during a burst at ~11:03 UTC. they report ~40% failures. request ids: r_6743a, r_6743b, r_6743c.
maya (oncall): pinging eng-sre + runtime. any obvious gateway/backpressure alerts?
samir (eng-sre): I see gateway 504 spikes + spike in queue length on the tenant route. gateway logs: ```[gateway] upstream connect timeout to 10.0.2.34:8080 after 60s```
jared (eng-runtime): grabbing model pool metrics for acme-121. initial look: model-loader time spikes — some pods take ~18-25s to become ready because of model weights transfer + GPU warmup. readiness probe only passes after loader finishes.
lucy (support): customer says they did a sudden surge (50 concurrent requests) after a campaign.
samir (eng-sre): checking autoscaling: KEDA ScaledObject for acme-121 has `minReplica: 0`, `pollInterval: 30`s, `cooldownPeriod: 30`s. HPA target and annotations mismatch (hpa.minReplicas=1 in k8s, scaledobject.minReplica=0). so scaling is inconsistent. also KEDA activationThreshold uses queueLength=10 which didn't trigger fast enough.
jared (eng-runtime): that explains it — with minReplica=0 and pollInterval=30s the fastest scale path is: request arrives -> KEDA polls after up to 30s -> create pods -> pod init ~20s -> readiness -> route. Worst-case ~50s+ which hits gateway timeout (60s) and causes 504s.
maya (oncall): can we confirm any readiness probe failures?
jared (eng-runtime): yes, kube events show readiness probe failing until model loader completes. sample event snippet: ```Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----               -------
  Normal  Pulling    20s   kubelet            Pulling image "redwood/infer:prod"
  Normal  Created    18s   kubelet            Created container
  Warning Unhealthy  2s   kubelet            Readiness probe failed: rpc error: handshake timeout
```
samir (eng-sre): root cause looks like two-fold: KEDA config too conservative + long model init. combined they cause scale-up lag and gateway timeouts.
priya (cust-success): acme-121 is on standard SLA but this is high customer impact. they opened a ticket and asked for ETA. we need a mitigation now.
maya (oncall): mitigation options: 1) emergency escalate: set `minReplica: 1` for acme-121 scaledobject (fast), 2) reduce `pollInterval` to 5s and `cooldownPeriod` to 60s globally for tenant burst policies, 3) fallback route: route to a smaller quantized variant while scaling completes. which do we want me to apply?
jared (eng-runtime): apply minReplica=1 for that tenant immediately (low-risk). also enable an annotation to prefetch model shard from object storage on warm path: `redwood.io/prewarm-model: "true"` for heavy models. we'll roll a targeted runtime config to prefer cached weights on dedicated pools.
samir (eng-sre): I'm +1 for minReplica change. I can patch scaledobject now. I'll also add a short-term KEDA tweak for burst-priority namespace: `pollInterval: 5`, `activationThreshold: 2`.
lucy (support): I patched the customer's scaledobject to minReplica=1 and notified acme that we're taking emergency action. their telemetry shows immediate drop in 504s (prelim).
ops-bot: Created escalation INC-20260317-1234.
priya (cust-success): I'll send acme a note with timeline and next steps (prewarm + config changes). please include expected RCA and mitigation ETA.
jared (eng-runtime): follow-up: we should instrument model-init latency per model and add a prewarm recommendation for models >500MB. also short-term implement a graceful 120s gateway timeout for burst routes while we optimize. longer term: baked prewarming and model cache on node pool.
samir (eng-sre): filed GH issue infra/keda-config#452 to standardize burst settings and to add an alert when scaledobject.minReplica=0 for tenants flagged high-SLA.
maya (oncall): thanks. next steps: (1) verify no other tenants impacted (running scan), (2) implement keda tweaks for burst-namespace, (3) jared to propose runtime prewarm rollout. I'll keep this thread open and post final RCA. :thumbsup:
lucy (support): thanks all — customer is watching. will update when acme confirms.
